def f(I):
    A=np.array(I); h,w=A.shape; o=A//3

            blk=A[3*i:3*i+3,3*j:3*j+3]
            cnt={c:(blk==c).sum() for c in np.unique(blk)}
            best=max(cnt.items(), key=lambda kv:kv[1])
            out[i][j]=best[0] if best[1]>0 else 0
    return out

print(np.array(P))
print(np.array(B)==np.array(P))
